# IFireballRules.StunDuration property

How long a runner the fireball touches stays stunned: 1.5 seconds by default. As for every stun in the game, a runner already stunned is not stunned again above 1.75 seconds left, and otherwise keeps at least 0.5 seconds.

```csharp
public TimeSpan StunDuration { get; set; }
```
